9540500 (HEAD -> master) Modified bmpio allow reading from files with newer formats. * No longer restrict the infoheader to be 40 bytes. * Add 2 bpp bmp file to mtiff_reg test. * Addresses issue #454
fe5be6c Add autoinvert for regions where the text may be white on black bg. * This is a tesseract OCR request. * Issue #447
b5e0d8c Finish adding #include config_auto.h to all src files in the library. * This resolves part of Issue #454.
7cfbcdf Remove calls to pixSaveTiled*() from all files in prog/. * These are replaced by using pixaDisplayTiledInColumns() to compute   the locations of the sub-images.  pixaaDisplayByPixa() is also   used when the number of images in a row needs to vary within the mosaic. Remove pixaDisplayOnColor(): not used. Make smallpix_reg into an actual regression test; added to alltests_reg.
387d398 Deprecate three pix display functions: pixSaveTiled*().   * These are removed from the library. * Also removed some, but not all, from prog. * Replaced implementation of pixaaDisplayByPixa() with a much   simpler one. * Added prog/underlinetest.c, giving examples of removing lines under text
3f38a79 Update README.md
a5ba667 Make versions of boxaWriteStream() and numaWriteStream() for stderr. * Use NULL in the general function for the stream to go to stderr. * These will be redirected if necessary.
8cfe39e Remove "return" on 2 functions returning void in map.c
4f25104 Replaced all fprintf(stderr, ...) with lept_stderr(...) in the library * This completes the stderr redirection. * Also included auto_config.h in this set of about 80 changed files
85e2727 Merge pull request #469 from 1480c1/cmake2
167b567 Merge pull request #468 from 1480c1/cmake1
adb4d4f Merge pull request #467 from 1480c1/cmake0
57a18c0 CMake: Use BUILD_SHARED_LIBRARIES and get rid of LIBRARY_TYPE
9a8548a CMake: Only expose SYM_LINK if UNIX
dee05db CMake: Only apply msvc flags if msvc and use checkcompilerflag
2e2a9dd Add stderr redirect callback mechanism. * Fixes issue #388 * Solution provided by jbarlow83. * Use it for both error message return functions (e.g., ERROR_INT)   and informational output (e.g., L_WARNING). * The replacement of fprintf(stderr, ...) by lept_stderr(...),   which occurs in about 450 places in the library, has not yet   been done. * Test in prog/messagetest.c.
54cfd24 Modified handling of 1 bpp colormap tiff read/write * When read, the 1 bpp colormap is removed based on its content.   For example, if it has color, a 32 bpp rgb pix is generated. * When written, the 1 bpp colormap is preserved. * Added tests in ioformats_reg.
a0b5d7a Issue #465: photometry incorrect on 1 bpp tiff with color * need to remove the colormap when it is read in. * invert the pix if min-is-black in the colormap.
a414068 Update build instructions on Windows with sw.
ef5ea09 Added checkerboard.c to Makefile.am * to fix build break in oss-fuzz, issue 19077
